look: Midday vox pop at shuttered bank
prompt: A photorealistic 16:9 frame from a cheap street-interview documentary, shot handheld on a shoulder camcorder with a slightly wide lens, the hard midday Asuncion sun the only light, short black shadows on hot pavement. A presenter wears a mustard-yellow chunky rib-knit wool balaclava over his whole head, the knit one continuous unbroken surface across the face, pilled and fuzzy, its neck tucked into a crumpled black suit jacket and a creased white shirt. look: Shoved through a night protest crowd
